g.text: Module 2 · Controlled reading in the actual prefix-cache protocol
Top: transparently selected illustrative pairs (12/12 pairs improve the mass ratio for both opposite patients).
Bottom: all 24 prompts / 12 paired configurations / 3 guides; intervals resample guides. Masses average selected KV heads and their shared queries.
Oracle routing signs · simultaneous selected-head editing · fixed unit-key gains. Score-bias calibration is fixed on selection data, not matched per confirmation example.
